description: The dates stream of ADR 0024 section 6: the rule stream <row path> + ("rule", R) of a date column that a lifetime's duration or a within entry sets, with R the canonical JSON of ["dates", <column>], and the duration draw on integer thresholds. Every block word is 16 hex digits, every integer a decimal string. Computed by tests/kernel2/test_dates_vectors.py from tests/kernel2/reference.py, never typed.
